meta.title: Product Architecture
meta.description: High-level view of Loquor AAC product systems, communication capabilities, and operational workflows.

hero.title: Product Architecture
hero.description: Loquor AAC is designed as a communication platform with layered support for users, caregivers, and clinicians.

pillars.title: Communication Modes
pillars.description: Switch between Standard Grid, Activity Boards, and Core-Fringe without changing the core message flow.

pillars.title: Language Intelligence
pillars.description: Context-aware verb conjugation, noun pluralisation, determiner helper, and form selection across Dutch, English, French, and Spanish.

pillars.title: Voice Output
pillars.description: Use device text-to-speech offline and optional ElevenLabs voices online with automatic fallback.

pillars.value: Structured growth from starter to expert
pillars.title: Progressive Learning
pillars.description: Unlock vocabulary in 6 levels with readiness checks, ghost slots, motor memory protection, and per-language progression tracking.

pillars.value: Caregiver and SLP controls built in
pillars.title: Clinical Admin
pillars.description: PIN-protected controls for content editing, user setup, language operations, layout management, and vocabulary pack installs.

pillars.title: Privacy and Portability
pillars.description: Local-first storage with user-initiated selective backup and restore. No cloud, no tracking, no conversation history stored.

featureSections.title: Communication Engine
featureSections.summary: Compose with symbols and text in one flow, then speak or share with minimal friction.
highlights: Message builder with symbol plus text composition
Prediction and abbreviation expansion behaviour
Long-press verb/noun form picker before adding to message
Favourites and category workflows
Share output controls in admin settings

featureSections.title: Grid Systems
featureSections.summary: Choose a communication model that matches cognitive load, context, and care goals.
highlights: Standard category grid with motor zone preservation
Activity board navigation for routines
Core-Fringe layouts with pinned core words and multi-page navigation
In-grid editing with drag, add, and remove interactions

featureSections.title: Smart Grammar Engine
featureSections.summary: Context-aware conjugation for Dutch, English, French, and Spanish - all offline, all automatic.
highlights: Verb conjugation: present, past, perfect, continuous, future tenses
Modal verbs, reflexive constructions, multi-clause sentences
French: elision, interrogative inversion, noun phrase gender agreement
Noun pluralisation via long-press with grammar reconjugation
Grammar bar with colour-coded determiner chips
Three assist levels: Simple, Standard, Expert

featureSections.title: Progressive Vocabulary
featureSections.summary: A 6-level learning system that protects motor memory while growing vocabulary through demonstrated usage.
highlights: 6 levels with per-level evaluation pools (only new words count)
Motor memory protection: word positions never change
Ghost slots preview locked words without enabling interaction
Floating Readiness Button with live percentage progress
Expert Vocabulary toggle for Level 6 words
Per-language independent progression state

featureSections.title: Voice and Output
featureSections.summary: Maintain communication continuity across network conditions and provider failures.
highlights: Device voice provider with configurable pitch and rate
Optional ElevenLabs integration with local audio cache
Automatic fallback to device speech on any failure
Preview and provider switching in admin settings

featureSections.title: Clinical Admin and Content
featureSections.summary: Structured operations for care teams managing symbols, layouts, users, and settings.
highlights: Settings, Content, Language, and Users administration
PIN protection and admin lock behaviours
Symbol, phrase, abbreviation, board, and layout management
Vocabulary pack install, grammar data sync, and reset flows

featureSections.title: Data and Portability
featureSections.summary: Keep communication data local and portable when teams migrate or duplicate setups.
highlights: Selective backup and restore with category toggles
Embedded image portability in .vbaac backup payloads
Multi-user profile isolation with separate databases
Duplicate-user and migration workflows
